hero.intro: Two days of talks on data science, biostatistics, machine learning and artificial intelligence, given by speakers from academia and industry.

about.title: Talks that turn data into decisions
text: DSATalks brings researchers, students and practitioners together at Adana Alparslan Türkeş Science and Technology University for two days of talks on how data is collected, analysed and turned into decisions.

From healthcare data and clinical decision making to MATLAB for data scientists, from the history of data science to the latest trends in its lifecycle, each talk looks at a different side of working with data.
organizers: Adana Alparslan Türkeş Science and Technology University
Department of Data Science and Analytics
International Conference on Data Science and Analytics (CONFDSA)
